description: Supporting dataset: Are we underestimating peak loads? Effects of temporal resolution, spatial aggregation, and household characteristics in energy models is a data set deposited in OSF (Open Science Framework) by its authors Baxter Kamana-Williams. This dataset contains 74 csv files, each of which contains 1-minute electricity demand profiles for 100 households for 30 days, for a range of household characteristics and external conditions in Auckland, Aotearoa New Zealand. The first column of each file contains the timesteps, and columns 2-101 contain electricity demand profiles for houses 1-100. Coverage: national (NZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-osf-repository.
